804c78c9f547a2e2cacd9cc97db5c64766fb4a25.source:
• Efficient and portable representation:

    • Compact: has a 66C4B5AA4816 that is fast to transmit by being smaller than typical text or native code formats.

    • Modular: programs can be split up in smaller parts that can be transmitted, cached, and consumed separately.

    • Efficient: can be decoded, validated, and compiled in a fast single pass, equally with either just-in-time (JIT) or ahead-of-time (AOT) compilation.

    • Streamable: allows AF65D4315CB1, EFD8F75B7EF3, and compilation to begin as soon as possible, before all data has been seen.

    • Parallelizable: allows AF65D4315CB1, EFD8F75B7EF3, and compilation to be split into many independent parallel tasks.

    • Portable: makes no architectural assumptions that are not broadly supported across modern hardware.
804c78c9f547a2e2cacd9cc97db5c64766fb4a25.translation:
• 高效和便携 任职人数:

    • 压缩: 有一个 二进制格式 以小于典型文本或本地代码格式的方式快速传输。

    • 模块:程序可以分成较小的部分,可以分别传输,缓存和消耗.

    • 高效:可以解码,验证,并编译为快速单行道,与正时(JIT)或前时(AOT)编译相同.

    • 可流性: 允许 解码, 验证,并尽快开始汇编,在所有数据被看到之前。

    • 可平行: 允许 解码, 验证,并编译成许多独立的并行任务。

    • 可移植:不提出在现代硬件中得不到广泛支持的建筑假设.

9c3e7198522a8e5ea05ede69e88c63fc3d555d22.source:
• Fast, safe, and portable semantics:

    • Fast: executes with near native code performance, taking advantage of capabilities common to all contemporary hardware.

    • Safe: code is validated and executes in a memory-safe [2], sandboxed environment preventing data corruption or security breaches.

    • Well-defined: fully and precisely defines valid programs and their behavior in a way that is easy to reason about informally and formally.

    • Hardware-independent: can be compiled on all modern architectures, desktop or mobile devices and embedded systems alike.

    • Language-independent: does not privilege any particular language, programming model, or object model.

    • Platform-independent: can be embedded in browsers, run as a stand-alone VM, or integrated in other environments.

    • Open: programs can interoperate with their environment in a simple and universal manner.
9c3e7198522a8e5ea05ede69e88c63fc3d555d22.translation:
• 快速、安全、便携 语义:

    • 快点: 执行时具有接近本土的代码性能,利用所有当代硬件的共同能力.

    • 保险: 代码被验证并在内存安全下执行 [2]防止数据腐败或安全漏洞。

    • 定义良好:充分而精确地定义了有效的程序及其行为,其方式容易以非正式和正式的方式解释.

    • 硬件独立:可以在所有现代建筑,桌面或移动设备以及嵌入式系统上编译.

    • 语言独立:不特权任何特定语言,编程模型,或对象模型.

    • 平台独立:可以嵌入浏览器中,作为独立的VM运行,或者在其他环境中集成.

    • 打开:方案可以以简单和普遍的方式与其环境相互操作。
